mapper.select: SELECT r.ROOM_ID, r.MEMBER_ID AS MEMBER_ID, r.LAWYER_ID AS LAWYER_ID, r.CREATED_AT, CASE WHEN r.MEMBER_ID = #{memberNo} THEN r.LAWYER_ID ELSE r.MEMBER_ID END AS TARGET_MEMBER_NO, CASE WHEN r.MEMBER_ID = #{memberNo} THEN m2.NAME ELSE m1.NAME END AS TARGET_NAME, lm.CONTENT AS LAST_MESSAGE, lm.CREATED_AT AS LAST_MESSAGE_AT, NVL(un.CNT, 0) AS UNREAD_COUNT FROM TB_CHAT_ROOM r JOIN TB_MEMBER m1 ON m1.MEMBER_ID = r.MEMBER_ID JOIN TB_LAWYER l ON l.LAWYER_ID = r.LAWYER_ID JOIN TB_MEMBER m2 ON m2.MEMBER_ID = l.MEMBER_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ROOM_ID, CONTENT, CREATED_AT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ROOM_ID ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC) AS RN FROM TB_CHAT_MSG ) lm ON lm.ROOM_ID = r.ROOM_ID AND lm.RN = 1 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ROOM_ID, COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM TB_CHAT_MSG WHERE SENDER_ID != #{memberNo} AND READ_YN = 'N' GROUP BY ROOM_ID ) un ON un.ROOM_ID = r.ROOM_ID WHERE r.MEMBER_ID = #{memberNo} OR r.LAWYER_ID = #{memberNo} ORDER BY NVL(lm.CREATED_AT, r.CREATED_AT) DESC
